verdict.rationale: Case management exists, but the documented review flow is a human reviewer working cases in the Customer Area UI. Nothing shows an API or MCP tool that lets an agent pull flagged cases with context or submit a recommended decision for confirmation. Webhooks flagging that a payment went to case management, and a general-purpose MCP server with no documented case-management scope, are only building blocks, not the agent review-queue capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the review queue — pull flagged cases with their context, summarize the evidence, and recommend a decision for a human to confirm

citations.quote: A reviewer then accesses the case in the Customer Area and accepts or rejects the transaction.
You can include risk information, such as whether a payment was sent to case management, and which risk rules triggered in these webhooks
Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
